self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Repentance and Redemption: triggering any Elemental Reaction grants +128 Elemental Mastery for 12s. Works off-field.
R5 Repentance and Redemption: triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction grants +32% ATK for 12s. Stacks with afterElementalReaction, since a Stellar Glimmer reaction is also an Elemental Reaction.

source.note: 7.0 weapon, added 2026-08-08 from nanoka 6.7.54 beta data (neither Amber nor GO carry it yet). Base stats derived as init x levels['90'] + last ascension add, the same derivation validated to the cent against 15 existing seed files. Buffs baked at R5 (house convention: 4* at R5, 5* at R1).

en.flavor: A greatsword passed down by the Luchkin. It is said that only the bravest warrior is qualified to wield it.

refinements.1: Triggering an Elemental Reaction increases the equipping character's Elemental Mastery by <r>64</r> for 12s, while triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction increases their ATK by <r>16%</r> for 12s. The aforementioned effects can trigger even when the character is not on the field.
refinements.2: Triggering an Elemental Reaction increases the equipping character's Elemental Mastery by <r>80</r> for 12s, while triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction increases their ATK by <r>20%</r> for 12s. The aforementioned effects can trigger even when the character is not on the field.
refinements.3: Triggering an Elemental Reaction increases the equipping character's Elemental Mastery by <r>96</r> for 12s, while triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction increases their ATK by <r>24%</r> for 12s. The aforementioned effects can trigger even when the character is not on the field.
refinements.4: Triggering an Elemental Reaction increases the equipping character's Elemental Mastery by <r>112</r> for 12s, while triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction increases their ATK by <r>28%</r> for 12s. The aforementioned effects can trigger even when the character is not on the field.
refinements.5: Triggering an Elemental Reaction increases the equipping character's Elemental Mastery by <r>128</r> for 12s, while triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction increases their ATK by <r>32%</r> for 12s. The aforementioned effects can trigger even when the character is not on the field.

fr.flavor: Une épée à deux mains transmise par les Luchkin. On dit que seul le guerrier le plus brave est digne de la manier.

refinements.1: Déclencher une réaction élémentaire augmente la maîtrise élémentaire du personnage équipé de l'arme de <r>64</r> pts pendant 12 s, et déclencher une réaction astrale augmente son ATQ de <r>16 %</r> pendant 12 s. Les effets susmentionnés peuvent être déclenchés même si le personnage équipé de l'arme fait partie de l'équipe mais n'est pas déployé.
